title: Students Lost ChatGPT and Their Grades Dropped by Half
description:
Turns out ChatGPT was doing the homework, not the students 😅

Roberto Serrano, an economics prof at Brown, switched his final to in person and got the lowest scores the course has ever seen. Out of 86 students, 19 failed, 18 walked out without really trying and 9 were so scared they just never showed up. And their take home work? Basically flawless, because the bot was handing everyone almost the same answers 🔥

It's not just one class either. A chinese study of 26,000 students found homework scores climbed 18% while exam scores fell 20, and at Berkeley the share of A grades on assignments jumped 13 points.

So now test scores and actual knowledge are two totaly diffrent things ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
